name.fr-FR: Essai sur l’origine, la signification et les privilèges de la médaille ou croix de saint Benoît
name.en-US: Essay on the Origin, Meaning and Privileges of the Medal or Cross of St. Benedict
name.pt-BR: Ensaio sobre a origem, o significado e os privilégios da medalha ou cruz de São Bento

description.fr-FR: Le petit livre de Dom Guéranger sur la médaille de saint Benoît (1862) : l’image de la croix et celle du saint, les lettres de la médaille, son origine, son usage, ses effets (XVIIe et XIXe siècles), l’approbation de Benoît XIV, les indulgences, le rite de bénédiction et la dévotion à saint Benoît.
description.en-US: Dom Guéranger’s little book on the medal of St. Benedict (1862): the image of the cross and of the saint, the letters on the medal, its origin, use and effects (17th and 19th centuries), the approval of Benedict XIV, the indulgences, the rite of blessing, and devotion to St. Benedict.
description.pt-BR: O pequeno livro de Dom Guéranger sobre a medalha de São Bento (1862): a imagem da cruz e a do santo, as letras da medalha, sua origem, uso e efeitos (séculos XVII e XIX), a aprovação de Bento XIV, as indulgências, o rito de bênção e a devoção a São Bento.

sources.edition: Essai sur l’origine, la signification et les privilèges de la médaille ou croix de saint Benoît, Paris-Poitiers, Oudin, 1862 (domgueranger.net HTML transcription)
sources.description: Checked in size against archive.org essaisurlorigine00gu (Oudin 1887).
sources.tierEvidence: Guéranger died in 1875; text first published in his lifetime or by 1931.
